manageServers: Register and monitor your own servers

empty.title: No servers yet
empty.description: Run projects on the shared pool, or bring your own server and register it here.

enrol.title: Register a server
enrol.description: Generates a one-time token the server uses to join.
enrol.label: Name
enrol.labelHint: Only to recognise it in this list.
enrol.needAdmin: You need to be an admin of an organization to register a server.
enrol.failed: Could not generate the token. Try again.
enrol.readyDescription: Three steps. The server takes it from there.
enrol.onceWarning: This token is shown once and cannot be recovered. Copy it before closing — it expires in 24 hours and works a single time.

install.then: The server appears here less than a minute after it finishes.

linux.title: Linux
linux.where: Run this on your server, as root
linux.hint: One line, and the server shows up here on its own.
linux.requiresWhy: The agent is one binary built on 24.04: on anything older it does not start. If your provider gave you Ubuntu 22.04 or Debian — what IONOS and OVH hand out by default — reinstall the machine with Ubuntu 24.04 before running this.

windows.title: Windows
windows.where: Run this in PowerShell, as administrator
windows.hint: It installs WSL with Ubuntu if it is missing, switches WSL's networking to mirrored —without that the instances cannot be reached— and runs the installer inside. A server on Windows is always on a private network.
windows.requires: Requires Windows 11 (build 22000 or later). On Windows 10, a Linux virtual machine with a bridged adapter.

private.title: It is on a private network
private.hint: An office, a VPN or your own machine: it takes the address it has on that network instead of the public one, and its instances are reachable from there only — with valid certificates all the same.

invitations.title: Waiting to join
invitations.description: Tokens issued but not used yet.

remove.title: Remove this server?
remove.description: {{name}} stops appearing in this organisation. The machine is not deleted: it stays up at your provider and will keep being billed until you delete it from their console.
remove.hint: It only leaves dooservice's register; the machine keeps running and being billed at your provider. Servers with projects on them cannot be removed.

detail.notFound: That server is not in this organization.
detail.noTelemetry: Nothing reported while this server is offline.

network.title: Server network and domain
network.explanation: Every server can have a domain of its own for its environments. And a server on a customer's network, behind a VPN, still works like any other — it calls the platform — except nobody reaches it from outside and its certificate is issued a different way.
network.private: It is on a private network
network.privateHint: No public IP, and no ports 80 and 443 open from the internet.
network.domainHint: Each environment will answer at name.this-domain. Leave it empty to use the platform's domain.
network.domainRequired: On a private network every server needs a domain of its own: the platform's would resolve, from anywhere, to an address only the customer's network can reach. Left empty, we use the server's own name.
network.domainTaken: Another server already uses that domain. Choose a different name.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.failed: The certificate could not be issued
certificate.none: No certificate yet. It is issued when the first environment is created.
certificate.explanation: It is issued by proving the name over DNS in our zone, without anyone reaching the server. The private key is made on the server and never leaves it. It renews on its own with 30 days to spare.

records.title: DNS records
records.weCreate: We create them, one per environment, in the server's domain.
records.none: No environments on this server yet.

add.title: Add a server
add.description: Create one at your cloud provider, or register one you already run.
add.createDescription: We create it in your Hetzner, DigitalOcean or Vultr account and it arrives ready to use.
add.enrolDescription: Issue a token and run one line on your machine.

create.title: Create a server
create.description: The server is created in your own account: the machine and the invoice are yours.

clouds.hetzner: The cheapest. Germany, Finland and the United States.
clouds.digitalocean: Includes São Paulo, closer to Latin America.
clouds.vultr: São Paulo, Santiago and Mexico City.

create.keyHint: We need a {{cloud}} key with read and write permission to create the machine. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
create.keyRejected: {{cloud}} did not accept that key. Check that it can write.
create.name: Server name
create.nameHint: Letters, digits and hyphens. This is the name it appears under here.
create.billed: The provider's monthly price, public IP included. {{cloud}} bills you directly.
create.catalogFailed: Could not read the provider's catalogue. Check your API key.
create.failed: Could not create the server. Try again.

summary.name: Name
summary.billing: The machine is created now in your {{cloud}} account and starts being billed from this moment, prorated by the hour. The price includes the public IP.
summary.neverDeleted: dooservice never deletes machines: if you do not want it afterwards, delete it from your {{cloud}} console to stop paying for it.

orders.title: Servers being prepared
orders.discardHint: Discarding only drops the order from this list. If the machine was created, it stays at your provider.

clouds.title: Clouds
clouds.subtitle: Your provider accounts, their machines and what they cost
clouds.empty: No machines in this account yet.
clouds.unreachable: Could not read the account. Check that the key is still valid.

update.requestedDetail: The server will install the new version and restart its agent within a few minutes. Your instances keep running.
update.failed: The update could not be requested
update.waiting: Updating… the version here changes when the server reports again.

state.currentDetail: It updates itself within its maintenance hours.
state.available: A new agent version is out: {{latest}}
state.availableDetail: This server will install it on its own in its maintenance hours; you can do it now.
state.requiredDetail: The platform sends it no work until it moves to {{latest}}. Your instances keep running. If it is older than 1.85.0, run this once on the server: curl -fsSL https://get.dooservice.sh/update.sh | sudo bash
state.failedDetail: It installed {{failed}}, it did not start properly and went back to the previous version on its own. Check journalctl -u dooservice-agent-update and try again.
state.failed: Could not move to {{failed}}; still on {{version}}

gitd.freeHint: Deletes cached copies no environment uses.
gitd.freeSafe: Copies in use are never deleted. If needed again, they are downloaded.

state.not_reached: There is a new platform; it is not this server's turn yet
state.waiting_window: New platform downloaded: it is applied in the maintenance hours
state.waiting_agent: Waiting for the agent to update before applying the new platform
state.blocked: The new platform cannot start yet
state.failed: {{step}} did not come up on its new version and went back to the previous one

platform.outdated: To update in the maintenance hours: {{names}}
platform.pendingImage_one: {{count}} environment has a new Odoo image: it takes it at its next deploy
platform.pendingImage_other: {{count}} environments have a new Odoo image: they take it at their next deploy
platform.earlyHint: This server gets each new platform right after our own servers, before everybody else.

server.agentWhenIdle: once it has no jobs · no downtime
server.gitdCacheHint: Clones shared by this server's environments.
server.needsAgent: Applies once the server runs agent 1.97.0
server.automaticHint: On: each release installs itself within the maintenance hours. Off: it is only installed when “Update now” is pressed, except mandatory security updates.
server.zonePending: This server has no time zone: its update hours are read in {{zone}}, its system's.
server.zoneWhy: The maintenance hours are read in this time zone. Your browser's is suggested.
server.zoneUnsaved: Not saved yet: {{zone}}, the server's system zone, is used today.
server.earlyHint: Receives each new release at the early access stage, about 24 hours after DooService's own servers and before other customers.
server.agentRestarts: The agent restarts to update when it is running no jobs; it does not cut service.
server.agentRolledBack: Agent {{version}} did not start and went back to the previous version.
server.pieceRolledBack: {{piece}} did not start on the new version and went back to the previous one.
server.applySharedHint: Restarts the shared pieces: cuts service 1–2 min. Each environment's Odoo image stays.

statusPage.title: Public status page
statusPage.hint: A page like GitHub's with this server's status, uptime and incidents, to share with your customers. It never shows its name, IP or projects.
statusPage.name: Title
statusPage.rotateHint: The current link will stop working.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.hint: Removes what no environment owns any more: containers, databases, folders, images, certificates and names. Daily, in the maintenance window.
cleaning.updateAgent: Update the agent so it cleans its leftovers.
cleaning.busy: The server was busy; it cleans on the next round
cleaning.nothing_other: {{count}} rounds with nothing to remove · last {{when}}

halted.too_many: Stopped: it would have removed too much
